Name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
Summary: Regional Qwen API with model-specific time-limited trials and PAYG. Coding Plan is excluded.

Credentials.Label: Regional general-purpose Model Studio API key

SetupSteps.Title: Choose region and scope
SetupSteps.Description: Use your own Alibaba Cloud account. New-user free quota currently requires Singapore and International scope. Complete account information before activation.

SetupSteps.Title: Copy the workspace API Host
SetupSteps.Description: Open Workspace Management. Use a regional general-purpose API key and the matching workspace host; region keys/models cannot be mixed.

SetupSteps.Title: Review Free Quota Only
SetupSteps.Description: Enable per eligible model in the desktop web console if desired. It is disabled by default and changes take time; lain does not change or verify this console setting.

SetupSteps.Title: Verify concrete model quota
SetupSteps.Description: Check remaining combined input/output tokens and expiry for the exact model or snapshot. Never treat trial-domain naming as proof of zero cost.

BillingPlans.Name: Eligible new-user model trial
BillingPlans.Scope: account + concrete model; RAM users shared
BillingPlans.ResetDescription: 90 days from the latest of activation, model release or access approval; exact expiry unknown.

account + concrete model; RAM users shared

BillingPlans.Notes: Only Singapore + International scope. Typically 1M tokens per eligible model; actual amount unknown. Input/output share one total. Separate model/snapshot quotas cannot be transferred.

BillingPlans.Name: Regional regular API
BillingPlans.Notes: Regular regional API can bill after quota exhaustion/expiry unless effective provider-side Free Quota Only protection stops it.

Routes.Name: Qwen3.8 Max · Singapore
Routes.FreeOnlyEnforcement: No independently verified billing cutoff; trial credit is not a free route.
Restrictions: Workspace ID is required. Account model access, quota eligibility and route capabilities remain unverified.
Other regions/scopes require separate explicit configuration and do not inherit the documented Singapore trial.

Sources.Title: Qwen API quick start
Sources.Notes: Virginia prose is internally inconsistent; copy actual API Host from console.

Restrictions: Coding Plan keys are prohibited for automated scripts, application backends and non-interactive use; this adapter rejects that plan and its endpoints.
Free Quota Only is disabled by default, per eligible model, console-managed and delayed; no request-level toggle is claimed.
Quota exhaustion under effective protection returns AllocationQuota.FreeTierOnly.
Without observable provider protection, free-only routing remains blocked.
Recommended regional workspace domains supersede legacy DashScope hosts, which stopped receiving new features after 30 September 2026.
